root_cause.before: A paused activity hovered by pointer had visible=true/pending=false. resetForScreenChange cleared model.isPointerInside but left mediaIdle.input.pointerInside=true, and no pending timer existed to rebuild.
root_cause.fix: After clearing the old screen pointer, resetForScreenChange re-evaluates mediaStateChanged() when the stored input still reports pointerInside=true. Existing pending deadlines continue with their remaining duration; new hovered-paused activity starts the normal three-second deadline. Identical metadata polls do not move an existing deadline.
root_cause.paths: Display selection/geometry, screen unplug, hide/fullscreen, disable/re-enable all share resetForScreenChange or update media input through mediaStateChanged.
root_cause.scope: PresentationController only; no coordinator/animation redesign, no new periodic timer.
